Method of Attack: Credential stuffing attacks using automated tools to make millions of login attempts using a list of user/password pairs; Use of 'configs' for credential-stuffing attack tools; Use of wordlists containing tens of millions of username and password combinations
Indicators of Compromise: Hundreds of 'configs' used by credential-stuffing attack tools found on devices seized from suspects
Dozens of wordlists containing tens of millions of username and password combinations
Goat Shop website selling hijacked DraftKings and FanDuel accounts
Stolen accounts sold on cybercrime marketplaces
